scope: Disposition of the first independent Claude verification-plan audit. No product implementation or main change.

findings.change: All parent/child rows carry scope, limitations and evidence. Conservative aggregation, nonempty progress evidence and 10 rejection controls prevent incomplete subclaims being promoted.

Exactly one execution applies only after durable reusable receipt/output and retained authority. Pre-receipt ambiguity requires safe re-execution or explicit refusal; no unsupported exactly-once side-effect promise.
20 independent held-out paired Lab tasks per targeted stratum, fixed primary estimator and paired bootstrap; six-task pilot cannot earn timing PASS. All pairs need valid accepted endpoints.
One preregistered run per arm per held-out cluster; fixed union-of-required-roles oracle, no best-of-k; clean controls separate.
The ledger binds exact PLAN.md bytes; prior plan+ledger are preserved with hashes and amendment reason; verifier checks history and staleness.

findings.status: achievable requirement corrected; impossible converse declined with proof
findings.change: Both UTF-16 and serialized-byte boundary triads plus multibyte/escaping probes are specified. Under-code-unit/over-byte straddle demonstrated. Reverse straddle cannot occur because standard serialized JSON byte length is at least code-unit length plus object syntax. No fake case is introduced.
